title: Signature Miner
subtitle: Mine attack n-grams from a corpus of suspicious payloads. Approve candidates and copy them as WAF rule TOML — paste into your rules file via the Config editor.

manual.hint: Paste your own attack/benign samples below and run the contrast miner on-demand. Results are separate from the auto-mined pipeline above.
attack.title: Attack Payloads
attack.description: One per line. Lift from tarpit / honeypot logs, blocked-request samples, etc.
benign.title: Benign Samples
benign.description: Clean traffic. N-grams common to both sets get downranked to avoid blocking legitimate users.
candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: {{n}} candidates — tick rows to promote, then Copy as TOML rules. Higher confidence + higher attack-support + lower benign-support = better signal.
empty.title: No Candidates
empty.hint: Try adding more diverse attack samples — n-gram document-frequency requires at least 2 attacks per pattern.
